story: NSA whistleblower warns of surveillance state
text: A year before Snowden took off to Hong Kong, William Binney was on a panel at Def Con where NSA surveillance was talked about at length, worth a watch - [VIDEO] lot of the stuff which was later leaked by Snowden is discussed here, nice to see Binney vindicated. Interestingly, the NSA facility in Hawaii where Snowden was working at the time is mentioned by name. I often wonder if this Defcon talk inspired him to do what he did.

story: 'Everyone in US under virtual surveillance' - NSA whistleblower
text: The Defcon video is similar: [VIDEO] (not sure if this link is bootleg) [LINK] (just the audio) has the ACLU and the same guy if that makes it more legit. The 10 zetabyte storage capacity estimate is based on building size. I think we need more details.

story: Could Glenn Greenwald go to jail? The law is alarmingly murky
text: The NSA is wholesale collecting data and later using a secret court to authorize them to query their own databases [1]. PRISM is not just an interface. It is officially known as SIGAD US-984XN which means it intercepts and collects electronic communications. [1] Bamford, Binney and the ACLU at Defcon 2012 [VIDEO]

I remember the DefCon 20 talk, Bigger Monsters, Weaker Chains with William Binney - [VIDEO] This was in 2012, 2013 was when Snowden did what he did. I always wondered if he saw this talk and was motivated by it.
